blocks.text: Complete narrative anthology from the shared Cyberpath development conversation

This document preserves all actual prose stories found in the supplied shared conversation. Later accepted rewrites are presented as primary versions. Earlier prose drafts are retained in the Archived / Superseded Story Drafts section.

Story plans, option tables, lore exposition, and unwritten seeds are excluded from the fiction anthology. The Corrected Child is marked unfinished because Part One was written and Part Two was only planned.
